Results.ReviewText: I really enjoy using my new Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill! Very easy to start the burners with the ignition system, grill meat and vegetables as well as the clean up. I like the Easy Access open side mount of the propane tank, easy to turn gas on and off as well as quick exchange of tanks. Important for an old fellow like me. The tank scale is a great feature giving you advance warning of how low you are on gas. Also like the tank lock system. Very impressed with the Grease Management system with disposable drip tray and the flavorizer bars. Most importantly grilling perfect brats, burgers and chicken is the best. I printed off the Grilling Guide which is very helpful. All in all this grill is a very good buy. Excellent value, quality at a very reasonable price. Never owned a Weber before and I am not disappointed with this purchase.
Results.Title: Quality Grill at Reasonable Price

I did a lot of reading and research online before choosing this grill.  It was a little more than I originally wanted to spend, but after seeing other reviews, I wanted to buy something reliable and something that would last, instead of something cheaper both in price and in quality.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
